scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,magenta "npm test --prefix backend" "npm test --prefix frontend"
scripts.render-build: npm ci --include=dev --prefix frontend &&npm run build --prefix frontend && npm ci --omit=dev --prefix backend
